title: fix(ui): keep spaces between joined settings strings
body: ## What Problem This Solves Settings joins a sentence and the value after it with no space, so the page reads "UI budget.Telegram probe timed out", "permissions.65/65 enabled." and "Session:agent:main:main". ## User Impact Those lines now read as written, with a space between the sentence and the value. The same fix applies to the Agents Skills count, the plugin consent "Previously accepted" date, and the session storage error. ## Why This Change Was Made Each site renders two values on consecutive JSX lines, and JSX drops the line break. This adds the missing space at each site and changes no copy or layout. ## Evidence Control UI mock, real navigation. The partial channel snapshot comes from the mock's `channels.status` response. The plugin consent and session storage fixes follow the same pattern and have no image. | | Before | After | | --- | --- | --- | | Agents Tools, Absolutely light, 1440px | | | | Agents Tools, CRT, 390px | | | | Channels, Absolutely light, 1440px | | | | Channels, Absolutely light, 390px | | | Checks: oxfmt, oxlint, `tsgo:ui`, `ui:i18n:verify`, `ui:check-performance:base`, and Channels view plus Agents tools unit tests (67 passed), with new tests for the channel notice, the enabled summary and the session key. The full suite was not run.
